title: Minigame: E10.1 Ammo Vehicle eligibility

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as a minigame of the Rules-first plan's proving slice (section 8): an Ammo Vehicle and a recipient, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a supply vehicle beside an AFV whose MA fires its caliber. E10 is not wired: its facts are entered by hand on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: A supply vehicle stands beside a tank short of ammunition.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
